title: Define stepwise interlock protocol for incremental PRD scope changes and cross-team signoff
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Why: Recent scope changes to the Private Upgrade PRD introduced ambiguity around acceptance criteria and staging for rollback. We need a lightweight, stepwise interlock protocol so engineering, design, legal, and PMs can (1) triage scope deltas quickly, (2) decide which changes require full signoff vs. expedited patch lanes, and (3) lock a deterministic acceptance matrix per PRD slice.

Goal: Produce a single-page Interlock Protocol document + checklist and an operational cadence for signoffs that reduces review cycle time by 40% while preserving legal and security guardrails. This ticket coordinates the cross-team alignment work, collects approvals, and hands off the final checklist to Eng deployment owners.

Scope: Establish rules for (a) decision escrow (defer non-critical decisions to post-launch window), (b) gated acceptance criteria for telemetry/regression checks, (c) explicit rollback criteria and owners, (d) when can changes be merged under expedited lanes, and (e) signoff matrix with SLAs for reviewers.
acceptance_criteria: Single-page interlock protocol published to Confluence with versioned header
Acceptance checklist with measurable gates: unit test coverage, e2e smoke, telemetry delta threshold, infra capacity signoff
Signed approvals (PM/ENG/DES/LEGAL) for initial PRD slice within 7 business days of doc publish
Runbook for expedited lane (emergency patch vs. full rollout) with named owners and rollback play
Telemetry queries and dashboards defined and owned by Observability team; noise baseline captured before rollout
Explicit list of decisions placed into Decision Escrow with owner and decision window
proposed_runbook: T-10 days: Publish pre-read (PRD diff + impact matrix) to #private-upgrade and attach to Confluence
T-7 days: Cross-team alignment meeting (30m) to surface blockers; record minutes and action owners
T-6 to T-3 days: Design/Eng/Legal asynchronous review; reviewers post approval or comments in Confluence
T-2 days: Final sync (15m) to confirm acceptances and escrowed decisions; add signatures
Launch window: Execute rollout with telemetry probes and canary metrics; abort thresholds defined in checklist
Post-launch +72h: Decision escrow review for deferred items or re-evaluation if telemetry exceeds thresholds
